data_fields.name: dr_reset_window
data_fields.donor_constant: 18 s after the last aura of the group ends; resets only when no aura is active

data_fields.name: pvp_cc_cap
data_fields.donor_constant: 8 s default for grouped spells; per-spell limits 3 s (Binding Shot), 6 s (Wyvern Sting), 4 s (Paralysis)

data_fields.name: dr_group_applies
data_fields.donor_constant: stun and taunt apply to all targets (DRTYPE_ALL); other groups only to players (DRTYPE_PLAYER); positive spells none

best_idea: One diminishing-returns ladder (100 / 50 / 25 / immune) on the target, stepped per landed CC, reset after a quiet window, with a shorter CC refused against a stronger active one.
decision_why: Frankendom wants one CC ladder (Strategy rule c); the donor splits it into seven groups. Keep the numbers, the read-before-count order, the cap-then-ladder order and the bounce check; key them on one ladder, count the reset in server ticks, and make the cap an explicit per-ability field. The 18 s window is long for a fast duel: keep it as data and tune it down (proposed, not measured).
acceptance: A server test: a player hit by three harmful CCs from any mix of sources gets full, half and quarter length; the fourth is immune and the fight log says so; after the reset window with no CC active the next one is full length; a new stun that would be shorter than the one already on the target is refused.
